Mr. Subhash Godara, Addl. Advocate General, Punjab
 for the respondent/State.

The petitioner is seeking the concession of anticipatory bail in FIR No.151 dated 11.08.2022 for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC registered at Police Station Ranjit Avenue,
District Amritsar (Annexure P-1).
Case called, however nobody has entered appearance on behalf of the petitioner.
On the last date of hearing as well, nobody had appeared on behalf of the petitioner.

Learned State counsel, on instructions from ASI Surjeet Singh, has informed the Court that after the petitioner was extended the concession of interim bail on 27.09.2022, he had failed to join investigation.

It has also been brought to the notice of this Court by learned State counsel on instructions that the petitioner had fled away 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:093538 CRM-M No.44647 of 2022 2023: PHHC: 093538 from the country as per the statement given by none other than the father of the petitioner, Harpal Singh.
